No, that isn't what the output shows. The loss tool did not report "no loss." It returned an error: the source coverage this asset needs hasn't been prepared, so no observation was made. There is no loss result of any kind, neither zero nor positive.

The run metadata also lists no asset area (it's null), so the footprint may not have been processed at all.

What we can say: the run was configured with a 2020-12-31 baseline, a 30% tree-cover threshold, and a 0.5 ha minimum event size, using Hansen/UMD GFC-2025-v1.13 and JRC GFC2020 V4. The engine is early access.

What we can't say: whether any tree-cover loss occurred on ASSET-J since the baseline.

To get an answer, the source coverage needs to be prepared and the analysis rerun. Until then, treat the asset's loss status as unknown rather than clear.
